original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Reconstruct the rank ledger from original operations rather than trusting its aggregate.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Record the selected certificate and complex_profile rather than taking a PR headline as input.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: List the existing independent checks for the exact selected or candidate sources. Pick a new changed input, missing binding or distinct failure mode; stop with a handoff if the proposed arithmetic check is already covered.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.

actual_scope: Does PR2374's claimed window-free-optimal owner fill on the PR2322 T74 words survive an independent exact check, and is it optimal over all legal whole-helper fills (bin-pattern integer relaxation)?
scope_change_reason: Drawn on the adversarial-audit track (seed 71). The specific new implication of PR2374 is its optimality claim, which had no independent check; the bin-pattern integer program gives one by a different method and over a larger class.
bottleneck_link: Confirms that owner packing on the live T74 line is exactly exhausted (gain <= 1e-15), redirecting effort to word-level levers that change the paid profile.
stop_rule: Stop once the exact dual plus integer enumeration either exhibits a better idle multiset or proves none exists above kappa_2374 + 1e-15, with a below-root control.
evidence: owner_optimum.py: root of PR2374's idle multiset certified within 1e-15 of its claimed kappa; exact rational dual feasible on all 1163 patterns at kappa_2374 + 1e-15; exact enumeration of all integer solutions within the dual budget finds none; control at kappa_2374 - 1e-12 keeps PR2374's fill and all 25 survivors have its idle multiset.
author: Sagar Thakrar
ai_assistance: Prepared with substantial AI assistance: Claude Code (Anthropic, Claude Opus 5.5) wrote the certificate and text; a separate Claude subagent adversarially reviewed it. No independent human review is claimed.

open_questions.question: Were the PR2312 and PR2269 owner fills also at the exact integer optimum of their inventories?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It shows whether recent owner-fill PRs on the T74 line were at the packing optimum or left headroom.
open_questions.first_step: Run owner_optimum.py with their inventories, local profiles and published idle multisets.
open_questions.blocked_by: Their published idle multisets must be extracted from their packages.

open_questions.question: Which word-level move on the PR2322 words is cheapest to realize now that packing is exhausted?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Owner fills cannot add more than 1e-15; word-level moves are priced at +4.3e-8 (handoff) to +1.46e-6 (cold-restoring an end-climb-3 helper).
open_questions.first_step: Attempt a PR601-style commutation test on the 64 end-climb-3 helpers (PR2429).
open_questions.blocked_by: Exact cleanup commutation semantics of the T74 words are not modelled here.
